{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the format of revenue
print("First 5 revenue values:", df['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Attempt to convert revenue to float after removing commas
# This will fail if there are any non-numeric characters
try:
    df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    print("Revenue successfully converted to float.")
except Exception as e:
    print("Error during conversion:", e)"}
